doc: Hull-token registry (W3-B; UW2 amendment 2026-11-04). The governor (tools/build_ui_art.py) renders EVERY authored map of a hull into staging — all eight directions are authored maps per the §4.8.6 amendment (a side-view ship does not rotate losslessly; docs authored on the amended shape carry maps × 8 and no derive entries; legacy n/ne + derive docs keep the pinned-op path until re-authored) — then applies the 1px HULL_INK outline and bakes the 9 owner variants via the wood-step remap table. Contract: docs/80-UI-UX.md §4.8 (heading8→dir table §4.8.6, tier footprint bands §4.8.7, hull block §4.8.4) and docs/10-DATA-SCHEMA.md §8.8 group 13.
staging: authored maps render into a transient staging dir (they are outline-less wood-colored intermediates; the wood-colored map itself is not a shipped file — every owner variant, neutral included, is a remap target per §4.8.4 hull block)

outline.rule: 8-neighborhood: transparent pixels adjacent (8-way) to opaque ones take HULL_INK

footprint._doc: §4.8.7 amendment 2026-11-04, 64-canvas values (amendment 1664ba9): the long axis is measured on the side view (e/w — the profile shows the ship's length), on the final outlined 64×64 canvas (×2 of the retired 32-canvas bands); the stern/bow views (n/s) show the beam and the diagonals are the honest 3/4 views — all unbanded, canvas-fit only (bbox + outline ≤ 64)
